fact: The IPDCP's legal-framework page lists Togo's Law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on personal data protection and Decree 2020-111/PR among national texts, beside the ECOWAS Supplementary Act A/SA.1/01/10 and the Malabo Convention as regional texts.
title: Cadre Juridique
publisher: Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)
